title: Padded-clone value is bounded by its optimum
statement: Let $D$ and $V$ be finite sets, with $D$ nonempty, and let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with a uniform refinement over a finite predicate template. For natural numbers $r,M$, suppose every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. For every assignment of values in $D$ to $V\times\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$, its padded-clone value is at most the optimum padded-clone value.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$
